title: Contrix Standard Event Payloads
description: Common payload contracts for registered cx.* Event.kind values. Event validators MUST combine these payload classes with artifacts/registry/event-kind-registry.json.

member_delivery_binding.description: Per-Realm binding of a member to a concrete delivery target service. Authoritative source for Realm-scoped event / sync / to-device / push / key-package delivery; sender MUST NOT consult the actor's DID Document service entry as an alternative resolution path when this binding is present. Pairwise / unlinkability use-cases are orthogonal — see identity-did.md and pairwise DID guidance.

recipient_service_did.description: service DID of the recipient Principal Server for this member in this Realm.

recipient_service_type.description: v1 only allows principal_server. Anchorer / shared sync service are addressed by Realm-level sync_endpoints, not by member-level delivery_binding.

binding_scope.description: v1 only allows realm-scoped bindings. Organization-wide or DID-global bindings are out of v1 scope; they would be expressed by Realm policy + organization registry instead.

binding_source.description: How the binding was determined at join time. 'explicit' = user / admin chose; 'did_document_default' = resolved from invitee DID Document (only allowed when Realm policy enables fallback); other values are policy-driven.

delivery_modes.description: Explicit allow-list of delivery modes for this binding. Empty / absent is NOT permitted; implementations declaring a 'full' member SHOULD list all five values.

service_endpoint.description: Optional cached HTTPS endpoint of recipient_service_did at resolved_at. Diagnostic / fast-path hint only; sender MUST re-resolve via DID Document before federation transactions and SHOULD verify endpoint matches the service DID's current binding.

did_document_digest.description: Canonical hash of invitee's DID Document at resolved_at. Required when binding_source = did_document_default.

resolved_at.description: Wall-clock time at which the binding was resolved. Always required so that downstream verifiers can decide whether the resolved state is still acceptable under their freshness policy.

service_acceptance_ref.description: Reference to the recipient service's prior service_acceptance / endorsement Event. Required when binding_source = explicit or organization_policy; reducer MUST verify the referenced Event is signed by recipient_service_did and its scope covers this Realm.

holder_proof_ref.description: Reference to the member's DID proof (challenge-response) that bound the DID to recipient_service_did at the auth/account layer. Required when the member did not submit the join Move directly from a session at recipient_service_did.

policy_event_ref.description: Reference to the Realm / Join / Organization policy revision that authorised this binding. Required when binding_source ∈ {join_policy, organization_policy, realm_policy}.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry. After this timestamp the binding is no longer usable for delivery; senders MUST quarantine pending events and the member MUST submit a rebind Move (same-state join self-transition) carrying a fresh binding. Sender behaviour is fail-closed: MUST NOT fall through to DID Document on expiry.

anchor_frontier.description: Accepted Anchor frontier expressed as event_digest hash values, not cx:event typed ids. The hash algorithm is the enclosing Realm or control stream hash profile.

board_space_id.description: A Space with kind=board. Pattern matches any cx:space:; kind invariant enforced by reducer/profile.

track.description: Message timeline track. Mirrors message.schema.json#/properties/track: v1 Message payloads are restricted to 'discussion'.

not.$comment: Reject legacy discriminator field name `type`, legacy composite child array name `blocks`, and byte-count field `size`. The discriminator is `kind`, the composite child array is `parts`, and byte counts use `size_bytes` (see schemas/message.schema.json and forbidden-wire-fields.json `blocks/content_block_composite`).

verification_method.description: DID URL of a concrete verification method. Bare DIDs are not valid where a key binding is required.

agent_key_id.description: Stable key identifier within the agent DID. Prefer the DID URL verification method id when available.

patch_path.description: Contrix field patch path. Segments are snake_case identifiers, optional stable-key selectors (such as profile-declared named-collection arrays of the form `<field>[<key>=<value>]`), or backtick-quoted literals; numeric array indexes are not part of cx.patch.v1. v1 standard schemas no longer use stable-key selectors — Flow tracks is now a map keyed by track name, so paths like `tracks.discussion.profile` are plain object segments.

patch_value.description: A plain value is shorthand for {"$op":"set","value":...}. Objects containing $op MUST be patch_operation objects.

not.$comment: Object kind is derived from the typed-id prefix on `id`; `type` is a banned legacy alias.

object_snapshot.description: Embedded object snapshot inside an Event payload. Object kind is derived from the typed-id prefix on `id`; there is no separate `type` field.

not.$comment: Standard cx.* event payloads use kind (envelope) + payload schema discriminators. `type` is a banned legacy alias here to keep schema validation aligned with reducer behavior.

realm_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Realm object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

space_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Space object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

flow_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Flow object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

circle_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the Circle object schema for wire validation. Reducer validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match top-level created_at, then enforce parent Realm encryption floor. When payload.object.encryption_profile='mls_rfc9420', the reducer derives the independent MLS group binding for (realm_id, circle_id). payload.object.mls_group_ref is reducer-derived and MUST NOT be actor supplied.

morph_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Morph object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

object_stage_set_payload.description: Shared base shape for cx.<kind>.stage.set events. Each concrete stage_set payload class (flow_stage_set_payload / morph_stage_set_payload) extends this base by pinning the object-id field (flow_id / morph_id) and is referenced from event-envelope.schema.json conditional routing. The stage enum is the protocol-level 8-value set defined in zh/models/common-fields.md §5.3.2; profile MUST NOT extend or override the enum. Reducer hard invariants are listed in zh/models/common-fields.md §5.3.3 (terminal state freeze, non-active reject, reducer-derived stage_changed_at, same-value no-op, single-source via this event). The payload intentionally does NOT carry a reason / note / explanation field: this event log is the audit source (actor_id + created_at), and human-readable explanation belongs in a Message on an associated discussion track that 'references' this event. expected_stage compiles to a cell head_eq precondition and provides optimistic concurrency; omission is equivalent to no CAS.

expected_stage.description: Optional CAS precondition: when present, reducer compiles it to a cell head_eq comparison against the cell's current value. Mismatch yields failed_precondition reason=stage_cas_mismatch. Same semantics as cx.flow.watch.set's expected_value.

not.$comment: Reason / note / explanation fields are intentionally rejected. Stage transitions audit through the event log; human-readable rationale belongs in a Message on the discussion track that references this event.

flow_stage_set_payload.description: Payload class for cx.flow.stage.set. Mutates Flow.stage / Flow.stage_changed_at. Intentionally carries no reason field — see object_stage_set_payload description and zh/models/flow-and-message.md §3.2.

not.$comment: Mirror of object_stage_set_payload guard. Reason-style fields are forbidden; rationale belongs in a discussion-track Message.

morph_stage_set_payload.description: Payload class for cx.morph.stage.set. Mutates Morph.stage / Morph.stage_changed_at. Intentionally carries no reason field — see object_stage_set_payload description and zh/models/morph.md §2.

morph_schema_migrate_payload.description: Migration of a Morph's schema_refs[] under the schema-evolution policy (zh/models/morph.md §4.1 S3). Distinct from cx.morph.update — schema_refs[] changes MUST go through this event so the migration is auditable, capability-gated, and carries an explicit compatibility class. Reducer MUST verify the actor holds the cx.morph.schema.migrate capability (or the Realm-declared equivalent) at the event's frontier; missing capability yields capability_denied. Reducer MUST reject compatibility_class ∈ {breaking, transformation} unless the Realm declares cx.profile.morph.schema_migration_transformations.v1 (yielding morph_schema_refs_transformation_unsupported otherwise). Reducer MUST verify from_schema_refs[] matches the Morph's current schema_refs[] at apply time (yielding failed_precondition otherwise). The event's own requirements.schema[] MUST include the union of from_schema_refs[] and to_schema_refs[] so readers can resolve both versions during overlap. Each transformation_rules[] entry SHOULD describe a deterministic, replay-safe per-field mapping (rename, type widening, default backfill, etc.); the rule object shape is governed by the Realm-declared cx.profile.morph.schema_migration_transformations.v1 profile.

from_schema_refs.description: Expected current schema_refs[] of the Morph at apply time. Reducer MUST set-equal-compare against the Morph's state and reject mismatches as failed_precondition (semantic: optimistic concurrency on schema_refs).

to_schema_refs.description: Desired schema_refs[] after migration. MUST be a registered set of schema profile ids resolvable at apply time.

compatibility_class.description: additive: to_schema_refs[] only adds optional fields / lookup-compatible profile refs; no historical event needs reinterpretation. breaking: to_schema_refs[] removes or tightens fields; future events follow new schema but historical events keep validating under from_schema_refs[]. transformation: a per-event data transform is needed to map old payload shape to new (requires explicit transformation rules). Core reducers MUST accept additive only; breaking and transformation require the cx.profile.morph.schema_migration_transformations.v1 opt-in Realm profile.

transformation_rules.description: Required when compatibility_class='transformation'. Each entry MUST describe a deterministic, replay-safe per-field mapping (rename, type widening, default backfill, etc.). The rule object shape is governed by cx.profile.morph.schema_migration_transformations.v1 (see profile description in conformance-profiles.json).

migration_evidence.description: Optional anchor / witness evidence justifying the migration (e.g., governance proposal id, audit trail anchor). The event's authorization_ref carries the formal capability gate; migration_evidence is for human reviewers.

actor_profile_create_payload.description: Initial actor profile payload. In Move/Anchor/Lattice state, the profile cell subject is payload.object.id.

account_data_set_payload.description: Payload for cx.account_data.set. Writes one holder-private account-data key; the value may be cleartext inside an already private envelope, encrypted account-data material, or a tombstone.

account_blocklist_payload.description: Payload for cx.account.blocklist. Holder-private personal blocklist state; it never enters shared Realm state or federation payloads.

object_patch_payload.description: Generic patch payload for object families that do not define a narrower id-specific payload. The target object is single-sourced by target_ref; object_ref and target-less patch forms from earlier drafts are not canonical.

profile_realm_override_payload.description: Realm-scoped actor profile override payload. The event kind remains cx.profile.space_override for wire compatibility, but the semantics and target selector are Realm-scoped. target_ref is the Actor Profile being overridden; target_realm_id is the Realm where the override applies.

circle_patch_payload.description: Payload class for cx.circle.update. Patch path MUST NOT contain realm_id, encryption_profile, mls_group_ref, state, state_changed_at, created_by, or created_at; reducer enforces the path-level lock and semantic policy floor checks.

object_lifecycle_payload.description: Generic lifecycle payload for Flow / Circle / Morph archive-restore-tombstone style events. The target object is single-sourced by target_ref; target_state may describe the intended lifecycle result but cannot replace the target object reference.

circle_member_state_payload.description: Payload for cx.circle.member.state. Parallel to cx.member.state but scoped to a Circle; reducer MUST verify actor_id is an active member of the parent Realm before any transition to active, and MUST reject self-unban/self-unremove paths.

circle_anchor_commit_payload.description: Reducer-derived payload for cx.circle.anchor_commit. Commits an opaque Circle sub-anchor head digest into the parent Realm Anchor stream at the profile-defined cadence.

restricted_policy_digest.description: Required when value=restricted. Digest of the effective cx.realm.history_sharing_policy value that defines restricted history visibility.

default_key_share.description: Baseline key-share rule before restricted_rules are evaluated. event_time_visibility still requires T0 history visibility, current safety policy, and receiver device checks.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable account status diagnostic. Values that cross service or federation boundaries MUST be registered in error-code-registry.json reason_codes (for example deactivation_federation_incomplete).

space_state_transition_payload.description: Payload for cx.space.archive and cx.space.restore. The target Space is expressed on payload.space_id; top-level target_ref is a rejected legacy field on Event envelopes.

space_object_tombstone_payload.description: Payload for cx.space.tombstone. Realm tombstone uses its separate Realm lifecycle payload; Space tombstone targets payload.space_id.

member_identity_update_payload.description: Payload for cx.member.identity.update. Append-only replacement event for one Realm-scoped member display/subject projection segment. Service-visible metadata names the segment and the prior events it replaces; the segment body is plaintext or the original encrypted envelope and MUST contain the complete data for that segment. Handle lifecycle is excluded from this event and is governed by cx.schema.handle_claim.v1 issuer claims.

segment.description: v1 core defines a single full MemberIdentity segment. Narrower segments require a future schema/profile revision that extends this enum or defines a new payload schema; v1 receivers MUST reject unknown segment values.

replaces.description: Prior cx.member.identity.update events in the same (realm_id, actor_id, segment) that this event supersedes for current profile projection. Referenced events remain immutable history.

payload_digest.description: sha256 over RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON of the replaced event's full payload.identity_payload carrier wrapper ({member_identity: ...} or {encrypted_payload: ...}). Prevents replacing a different payload under a reused or confused event id.

identity_payload_digest.description: sha256 over RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON of the exact identity_payload carrier object. It is a cache invalidation key, not a substitute for signature or MLS verification.

expected_state_digest.description: Optional optimistic concurrency guard for the current effective set of this (realm_id, actor_id, segment). When present, it MUST equal the writer-observed effective-set digest before applying this event: sha256 over RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON {realm_id, actor_id, segment, effective_events:[{event_id, segment, payload_digest}]}, with effective_events sorted by (segment,event_id). It is not the identity_payload_digest and not a roster member_display_state_digest.

data_classes.description: Closed machine-checkable classes of plaintext or reversible derived content this service may receive. Human-readable purposes do not replace this field.

join_policy_payload.$comment: Value-shape schema for the realm.join_policy.v1 cell (written as a sub-component of cx.realm.policy_components). Structural validation is JSON Schema; property-level gate_id uniqueness within gates[] cannot be expressed in pure JSON Schema 2020-12, so it is enforced by (a) reducer rejection with reason_code=join_policy_duplicate_gate_id and (b) tools/lint_artifacts.py check_join_policy_gate_id_uniqueness over fixtures and Markdown examples. uniqueItems below catches whole-object duplicates as a baseline. See zh/governance/join-policy.md §3 / §3.1.

application_ttl.description: Join application pending lifetime as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT168H.

cooldown_after_reject.description: Minimum interval before the same actor may reapply after rejection, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT72H.

read_receipt_policy_payload.$comment: Payload for cx.realm.read_receipt_policy. Closed object (additionalProperties=false) so that typos in the privacy-floor escape switch `allow_child_privacy_tightening_against_required` cause schema_violation rather than silent acceptance. The enclosing Event envelope already carries `realm_id`; the payload does NOT duplicate it. `minProperties: 1` aligns with the generic state_payload branch in event-envelope.schema.json (cx.realm.* policy events): an empty `{}` payload is semantically identical to never writing the event (cell stays null with the same effective defaults), so it MUST be schema_violation rather than a silent no-op. See zh/discovery/read-receipts.md §2.5.

allow_child_privacy_tightening_against_r.description: Privacy-floor escape switch. Defaults to false. When the parent policy sets disclosure='required' and this field is true, a child Realm MAY tighten disclosure to 'optional' or 'disabled'. Misspellings (e.g., a missing underscore) cause schema_violation because additionalProperties=false; runtime mismatches yield read_receipt_compliance_floor_violated.

allOf.$comment: cx.message.create payload MUST NOT carry revision_root. Reducer initializes revision_root := id on create; only cx.message.revise events may set it. See zh/models/flow-and-message.md §9 and forbidden-wire-fields.json `revision_root/message_create_payload`.

track.description: Active track of the target Flow. Optional on revise/redact: when omitted, reducers MUST resolve from the existing message identified by message_id / target_ref / revision_of. When present, MUST equal that resolved track.
Active track of the redacted message's parent Flow. Optional: when omitted, reducers MUST resolve from the existing message. When present, MUST equal that resolved track.

reaction_payload.description: Reducer input for cx.reaction.add and cx.reaction.remove. OR-Set membership is keyed on (actor_id, target_ref, key); a remove tombstones every prior add from the same actor with the same key in the causal past. See zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.9 for the plaintext-vs-encrypted policy.

key.description: Reaction key. Plaintext realms SHOULD use a single Unicode emoji cluster or registered short tag. End-to-end-encrypted realms with `aad_visibility != opaque_id` SHOULD carry a deterministic routing hash here (`sha256("cx-reaction-key-v1" || mls_group_id || epoch || canonical_emoji)`) so that OR-Set dedup, rate-limit and reducer convergence keep working without revealing the chosen emoji; the canonical emoji travels in `encrypted_payload`.

annotation.description: Optional free-form annotation (e.g. issue triage label). MUST be omitted when `encrypted_payload` is present; in E2EE realms the annotation MUST instead be carried inside `encrypted_payload`.

encrypted_payload.description: Encrypted carrier for the canonical reaction key and any annotation in E2EE realms. When present, plaintext `key` (if any) MUST be a routing hash and `annotation` MUST be omitted; OR-Set convergence runs after client-side decryption.

progress_basis_points.description: Progress in basis points (0..10000 = 0%..100%). v1 wire forbids non-integer numbers; producers MUST use integer scaled forms.

agent_key_scope.description: Closed authorization scope for an agent signing key. Resource selectors and actions are both explicit so the key cannot silently widen its authority through omitted dimensions.

agent_key_approval_evidence.description: Evidence that authorized this agent key. High-risk keys MUST carry an approval/proposal/capability reference that can be replayed at the event frontier.

agent_key_authorize_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.key.authorize. Binds one concrete agent signing key to an accountable principal, explicit agent_key_scope, audience, validity window, and approval evidence.

public_key_digest.description: Digest of the public key material behind verification_method. Required by high-assurance profiles when DID resolution is not pinned in the same anchor batch.

revocation_check_ref.description: Optional freshness source for revocation checking. Absence does not waive expires_at.

runtime_attestation.description: Optional runtime / workload attestation captured at pairing approval time (CXP-0008 §4.5). v1 enum includes self_asserted as baseline; future profiles MAY register TEE / SLSA / SPIFFE attestation kinds. Implementations encountering an unknown kind MUST fail closed.

kind.description: v1 enum. Future profiles MAY extend via accepted attestation taxonomy.

attestation_digest.description: Optional digest of verifiable attestation material when kind is not self_asserted.

evidence_ref.description: Optional external verifiable attestation reference (TEE quote, SLSA provenance, etc.).

agent_key_revoke_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.key.revoke. The or_set cell subject is (agent_principal_id, key_id); future protocol proofs from this key fail closed once this event is accepted.

revocation_frontier.description: Principal / Realm auth-state frontier under which this revocation was accepted.

agent_key_rotate_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.key.rotate. key_id names the retiring key used as the cell subject; replacement_key_id names the new key. Reducers MUST verify the accountable_principal_id is unchanged, agent_key_scope is equivalent or narrower, and expires_at does not extend the retiring key's effective TTL.

agent_lifecycle_frontier.description: Auth/key/grant freshness frontier captured when accepting an agent lifecycle transition.

agent_sidecar_exposure_ack.description: Controller acknowledgement of sidecar Circles that became newly visible or eligible while the agent was paused.

agent_pause_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.pause. The status cell is keyed by agent_principal_id and moves from active to paused under the captured freshness frontier.

agent_resume_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.resume. Reducers re-check controller, agent, key, capability, Realm policy, accountability grant, and any sidecar exposure acknowledgement before returning the agent to active.

agent_deactivate_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.deactivate. The terminal transition binds revocation fan-out to the same freshness frontier used to reject future agent sessions.

agent_action_target.description: Minimal target descriptor for an actor-private agent draft or approval. It identifies the eventual shared write surface without disclosing private draft content.

agent_draft_propose_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.draft.propose. Actor-private proposal that may materialize into controller-owned encrypted draft account data after policy checks.

agent_action_request_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.action_request. Actor-private request for controller approval before a shared Realm write is emitted.

agent_action_approve_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.action_approve. Controller approval binds the draft/action request, target, approved payload digest, expiry, and single-use nonce.

agent_action_reject_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent.action_reject. Controller rejection terminates a draft/action request without shared Realm side effects.

consent_grant_payload.description: Holder-private consent grant. The actor (consenter) is the holder; payload.peer is the counterparty whose contact is consented to. Wire-equivalent to a Move whose effect is add(tag,value) on the cell cx:cell:cx.component.consent.grant.v1:<consent_id> (or_set lattice); cx.consent.revoke writes a remove on the same cell. Lives in the holder's Principal Control Realm (or holder-private actor stream); MUST NOT be written to a shared Collaboration Realm. Realm role taxonomy: zh/models/realm-and-space.md §2.7.

consent_id.description: Stable identifier; used as the cell_subject of the consent cell. cx.consent.revoke MUST reference the same consent_id.

peer.description: Counterparty DID (or pairwise DID) that this consent applies to.

consent_scope.description: What kind of contact is consented to. 'invite' = peer may send Realm / Flow invites; 'direct_message' = peer may initiate 1:1 message; 'voice_call' / 'video_call' = peer may initiate WebRTC call; 'presence' = peer may observe presence; 'any' = full consent across all consent scopes.

constraints.description: Optional consent-specific constraints (rate limits, time-of-day windows, device restrictions). v1 does not standardise constraint types beyond capability constraint vocabulary.

evidence_ref.description: Optional reference to claim disclosure, presentation response, or invite proof that triggered this consent (audit trail).

consent_revoke_payload.description: Revoke a previously granted consent. Wire-equivalent to a Move whose effect is remove(tag) on the consent cell cx:cell:cx.component.consent.grant.v1:<consent_id> (the same cell written by cx.consent.grant). Payload observed_dots MUST match the Move effect's observed_dots so schema validation and audit can see exactly what was removed.

consent_id.description: MUST equal the consent_id of the cx.consent.grant being revoked.

observed_dots.description: Exact add dots being removed. A full revoke, including consent_scope=any cascade, MUST enumerate every active dot that becomes inactive; implicit cascade without dot enumeration is invalid.

verification_method.description: DID URL with required key fragment. Method-name normalized to lowercase per W3C DID 1.0; matches the strict form used by $defs/verification_method elsewhere in this schema.

revocation_frontier.description: Principal control stream frontier under which this device revocation was accepted. Shared Realm MLS Remove commits that rely on the revocation must cover this frontier directly or through an imported governance Move.

cross_signing_publish_payload.description: Payload for cx.cross_signing.publish. Schema cx.schema.cross_signing_publish.v1 (cross-signing-publish.schema.json) carries the authoritative shape; this payload entry mirrors the required-field set so the kind-specific payload class is wired into event-payload.schema.json dispatch. See device-lifecycle.md §5.1.

cross_signing_reset_payload.description: Payload for cx.cross_signing.reset. Schema cx.schema.cross_signing_reset.v1 (cross-signing-reset.schema.json) carries the authoritative shape; this payload entry mirrors the required-field set so the kind-specific payload class is wired into event-payload.schema.json dispatch. See device-lifecycle.md §14.1.

keypackage_digest.description: Canonical hash of the claimed MLS KeyPackage bytes. MUST equal the referenced cx.mls.keypackage.payload.keypackage_digest and claim_ref.keypackage_digest.

claim_ref.description: KeyPackage claim binding used by the receiver before decrypting the Welcome. claim_id, keypackage_ref, and keypackage_digest must match the top-level fields; capabilities_digest is sha256(JCS(claimed_capabilities)) from the single-use claim response; ssk_generation is the accepted cross-signing generation used when the claim was issued.

keypackage_digest.description: Canonical hash of the MLS KeyPackage bytes identified by keypackage_ref.

sender_device_signature.description: Detached device signature over canonical share metadata and ciphertext reference; verifiers MUST bind sender_device_id, recipient_principal_id, recipient_device_id, key_scope, aad_digest?, ciphertext/encrypted_key_ref and created_at.

policy_digest.description: Hash of the Realm policy / MLS governance policy root used to authorize this historical key share.

membership_frontier_digest.description: Optional hash of the membership frontier evaluated for history visibility and recipient membership.

base_epoch.description: Expected previous MLS epoch. MUST equal governance_binding.previous_epoch.

next_epoch.description: Committed next MLS epoch. MUST equal governance_binding.next_epoch.

audit_accessed_payload.description: Strict payload for cx.audit.accessed. It records a specific access or paired privacy-sensitive write. Reducers MUST reject business events that require an audit pair unless this payload identifies the same writer, target, and object/cell in the same Anchor batch or in an accepted pre-read event with RYW receipt.

late_recovery_original_event_id.description: Required when access_kind=e2ee_late_recovery; identifies the original encrypted event whose plaintext became available through late key recovery.

ryw_required.description: When true, plaintext release or privileged projection MUST wait for an accepted-history RYW receipt before disclosure.

board_space_id.description: Board Space that owns the position edge; deduplication key (board_space_id, flow_id) MUST be unique among active edges.

from_space_id.description: Source List Space (optional; reducer infers from current active edge if omitted).

target_space_id.description: Target List Space after move. This is the ONLY payload-level field for the destination; the reducer compiles it into the cas_register cell value as 'list_space_id' on the cell at cx:cell:cx.component.flow.position.v1:<board_space_id>:<flow_id>. Writers MUST NOT put 'list_space_id' directly on the cx.flow.move payload (additionalProperties=false enforces this) — there is exactly one destination input field on the wire.

space_id.description: List Space within which the reorder happens.

flow_watch_set_payload.description: Payload for cx.flow.watch.set. Writes the (flow_id, watcher_actor_id) watch cell. The new cell value is computed from payload.level + payload.level_public: when level is null the effect is set null (clear, equivalent to mentions_only); when level is a string the effect is set { level, level_public? }. Reducer invariants: (1) watcher_actor_id MUST equal envelope.actor_id unless writer holds cx.flow.watch.set.others; (2) when watcher_actor_id != envelope.actor_id (.others write), level MUST be one of {mentions_only, participating, all} and level_public MUST be omitted or false — writing muted or level_public=true on behalf of another actor MUST failed_precondition; (3) .others writes MUST carry refs[role=audit_pair] to a same-batch cx.audit.accessed event whose payload access_kind=watch_set_others identifies writer / target / cell / before-after heads. See models/flow-and-message.md §8.4.

level.description: Watch level. Required. null clears the cell (equivalent to mentions_only / no record); in that case level_public MUST be omitted.

level_public.description: Opt-in publication of the level value to non-self projection consumers. Default false. muted MUST NOT be exposed even with level_public=true. MUST be omitted when level is null.

expected_value.description: Compiles to cas_register head_eq precondition. Whole-value compare against the cell pre-state: either null (assert no prior record) or { level, level_public? } matching the prior cell value exactly. When omitted, reducers MUST treat it as head_eq null: only the initial write may pass; an existing cell MUST fail_precondition. Omission MUST NOT disable CAS or imply last-write-wins.

allOf.description: level_public MUST be omitted when level is null (clearing a cell does not carry a public-level setting).
